$Comment: A pool an ability can spend, steady and quick to come back: 100 at most, full when the carrier appears and after a respawn, refilling 1 point every 0.1 seconds (10 a second) while the carrier is alive, in a fight or out of one. Nothing raises it and nothing speeds its refill (no level, gear or talent line), so it is the same for everyone. A cost names it as any other pool: { "Stat": "Energy", "Amount": 35 }. A server owner retunes its maximum and its refill on the Stat Pools screen of the owner menu (/zigadmin), saved in mods/ziggfreedcommon/stat-pools.json; the ZigOwnerPool tag below is what lists it there, and the first Regenerating rule is the one that screen's refill retunes. Shown on screen by a stat bar file (Server/ZiggfreedCommon/StatBars/), since the game draws only its own bars.

Regenerating.$Comment: 10 a second, always: the refill an owner's RegenPerSecond retunes (its Amount over this Interval).
